description: This file defines the class TooManyEvaluationsException, which is a specialized exception class used when a maximum number of evaluations is exceeded in some computation. It extends MaxCountExceededException and customizes the construction with a localized message.

classes.name: TooManyEvaluationsException
classes.description: An exception class indicating that the maximum number of evaluations has been exceeded, extending MaxCountExceededException.

methods.name: TooManyEvaluationsException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with the maximum number of evaluations allowed, and adds a localized message to its context.
